questions.text: A change in a gene, called a mutation, can affect an organism. A mutation that occurs in a body cell like a skin cell will:
options: Turn the organism into a new species instantly
questions.explanation: Only mutations in sex cells (eggs and sperm) can be inherited. A mutation in a skin cell is not passed to offspring.

questions.text: Why do offspring produced by sexual reproduction show more variation than those from asexual reproduction?
options: They receive a mix of genes from two parents
They receive genes from only one parent
questions.explanation: Sexual reproduction combines genes from two parents, creating more genetic variation than asexual reproduction, which copies one parent.

questions.text: The fossil record shows simpler organisms in older rock layers and more complex ones in newer layers. This provides evidence of:
options: Change in life forms over long periods of time
That all species appeared at once
questions.explanation: The order of fossils in rock layers is evidence that life has changed, or evolved, over very long periods of time.

questions.text: In a population of beetles, green beetles blend into leaves and are eaten less than brown beetles. Over many generations, the population will likely have:
options: Beetles that are all the same color as the soil
questions.explanation: Natural selection favors traits that aid survival. Green beetles survive and reproduce more, so their trait becomes more common.

questions.text: The forelimbs of humans, whales, and bats have a similar bone structure. This similarity is evidence that they:
questions.explanation: Similar anatomical structures (homologous structures) across species are evidence of descent from a common ancestor.

questions.text: Which describes the relationship between the amplitude of a wave and its energy?
questions.explanation: A wave's amplitude relates to its energy. A wave with larger amplitude carries more energy.

questions.text: When light passes from air into water, it bends. This bending of light as it moves between materials is called:
questions.explanation: Refraction is the bending of light as it passes from one material into another, such as from air into water.

questions.text: You see yourself in a mirror because light does what off the smooth surface?
questions.explanation: A mirror reflects light. The reflected light forms the image you see of yourself.

questions.text: The planets stay in orbit around the Sun mainly because of:
questions.explanation: Gravity from the Sun, which has enormous mass, keeps the planets in their orbits.

questions.text: Geologists use rock layers to understand Earth's history. In undisturbed layers, the oldest rocks are usually:
questions.explanation: In undisturbed sedimentary rock, older layers are deposited first and end up on the bottom, with younger layers on top.

questions.text: The rock cycle shows how rocks change over time. Heat and pressure deep underground can change one type of rock into:
questions.explanation: Heat and pressure transform existing rock into metamorphic rock, one of the processes in the rock cycle.

questions.text: The matching coastlines and identical fossils found on the edges of Africa and South America support the theory of:
questions.explanation: Matching coastlines and fossils across oceans are evidence that the continents were once joined and have since moved apart.

questions.text: The San Andreas Fault is a boundary where two tectonic plates slide past each other. This type of boundary is most associated with:
questions.explanation: At a transform boundary, plates slide past each other and can suddenly slip, causing earthquakes.

questions.text: Scientists link recent rising global temperatures largely to increased levels of which gas from human activity?
questions.explanation: Burning fossil fuels raises carbon dioxide, a greenhouse gas that traps heat, contributing to rising global temperatures.

questions.text: In a chemical reaction, the total mass of the products equals the total mass of the reactants. This is the law of:
questions.explanation: The law of conservation of mass states atoms are rearranged but not created or destroyed, so total mass stays the same.

questions.text: A substance is tested and found to have a fixed melting point and reacts the same way every time. This suggests it is:
questions.explanation: Pure substances have consistent, characteristic properties like a fixed melting point. Mixtures vary depending on their makeup.

questions.text: Why is digital (0s and 1s) transmission of information often more reliable than analog signals?
options: Digital signals are less distorted by noise over distance
Digital signals travel faster than light
questions.explanation: Digitized signals encoded as 0s and 1s are more resistant to noise and can be transmitted and stored with less loss of quality.

questions.text: An engineer builds a model to test a design, then uses the results to make improvements. This repeating process is called:
questions.explanation: Iteration is the cycle of testing, analyzing results, and refining a design to improve how well it meets the criteria.
